description: 3rd place, FinzData AI Trading Championship (Oct 2026), 8 AI models, FinzData data only. Hypothesis (by GPT-OSS-20B): 20-day momentum plus high earnings yield captures trend and undervaluation. Out-of-sample 2019-01 to 2026-09: Sharpe 0.69, CAGR 14.0%, max drawdown -36.0%, but 9.3x annual turnover; judges marked it down because its own falsification test (Sharpe below 1) was met. Caveat: the models' training data covers the test period. Forward-tracked from publication.
title: AI Trading Championship 3rd: GPT-OSS-20B short-term momentum + value
